definitions.metric_granularity: document; distinct doc_id in ranked order, truncated to top_k
definitions.semantic_recall: recall_at_k against human relevant_doc_ids; denominator is the number of distinct gold docs, not K; not ANN recall
definitions.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first gold doc at doc rank r <= top_k; no gold in Top-K contributes 0; denominator is evaluated queries
definitions.rrf: sum over arms of 1 / (k + rank), rank starts at 1, k=60; raw dense/sparse scores are never added
definitions.candidate_union: interleaved dense[0], sparse[0], dense[1], sparse[1], ... after removing repeated chunk identities; score is a 0.0 placeholder because this baseline has no fused score
definitions.candidate_pool: first 10 hits from each retrieval arm
definitions.no_gold_handling: reciprocal rank 0.0 and no fabricated gold document
definitions.precision_at_k: |distinct doc_id in top_k ∩ known gold| / k; the denominator is always k, even when fewer than k documents are returned; duplicate doc_ids are collapsed in rank order before the cutoff; supplementary because labels are not exhaustive
definitions.precision_at_k_ceiling: min(distinct gold doc count, k) / k per query; the maximum Precision@K reachable on that query, not an observed ranking score
definitions.ndcg_at_k: binary nDCG: gain 1 for a known gold doc_id and 0 otherwise; DCG uses 1 / log2(rank + 1); IDCG uses the same k cutoff over the full known gold set; non-gold ids are unlabelled, not asserted irrelevant
definitions.labels_exhaustive: False; non-gold ids have not been judged irrelevant
definitions.relevance_scheme: binary_known_gold; only existing gold ids receive relevance 1
definitions.latency: wall-clock milliseconds per retrieval call, including query embedding for dense; one warm-up pass precedes timed passes

limitations: The corpus has one chunk per document, so chunk-level and document-level candidate sets coincide here.
Sparse OR already retrieves all 43 gold references (38 distinct documents), so hybrid recall cannot exceed 1.0 on this dataset.
The 30 queries are English; Chinese and mixed-language hybrid retrieval are not evaluated.
Precision@K and binary nDCG@K are supplementary and label-limited: non-gold ids are unlabelled, not confirmed irrelevant.
Host execution may differ from the pinned container environment; see environment.dependency_versions.
This run measures quality and latency at 150 chunks, not scale or concurrency behaviour.
